If people are not familiar with AppImage, it is a cross-platform, packaging for applications to run on GNU+Linux. It provides a uniform environment in which the application will run, regardless of the operating system on which it is installed. That is very handy for providing feedback on bugs to the developer. It ships with all the code the application needs to run. That helps with dependencies. It is also sandboxed, to provide greater security for your system. It also is the packaging which best supports Freedom at the moment.
